title: A Learned Policy Behind a Guard: Inputs Nobody Trained On, Outputs Past the Limit, and a Controller to Hand Over To

artifact.note: a guard round a learned policy: it hands over to a plain hand-written controller when an input is not a number, when the state is further from the training data than a set number of spreads, or when the network's output is not a number, and it clips an output past the car's limit; why it acted, the share of steps it handed over, and what the guarded clone of 38-05 does from wide starts and from narrow ones, with the threshold set tight, right and loose
